final_config.knob_notes: Roles are question types. models/thinking/max_tokens_by_type are keyed by question type; batch_size = questions of one type answered in one JSON call (1..12): fewer calls and less repeated prompt, but one bad reply loses the whole batch. A type's failures are wrong:<type>, bad_json:<type>, truncated:<type> (hit max_tokens), slow:<type> (mean call latency > 20 s).

changelog: v0: one model for every question type, reasoning on, one question per call

v1: config_set {"key": "batch_size", "value": 3} - Increasing batch_size from 1 to 3 reduces the number of API calls per task by grouping multiple questions of the same type into a single call, lowering overhead and cost. With 4 roles and ~3 calls per role currently, batching can reduce total calls by up to ~60% without affecting correctness if outputs remain valid JSON. The current cost per task is $0.012851; reducing calls should cut cost significantly. [1] supports batching for inference efficiency. [dev gain +0.000; cheaper at equal score: cost -32%]
headline: Held-out: accuracy 0.979 -> 1.000 at 70.4% of the cost per task; p50 call latency 9.672 s -> 19.013 s.
